name: @solx/http
description: Pure-fetch HTTP client for solx-server. Browser-safe counterpart to the Neon-backed *.connect() managers — re-exported under solx/http.
//: @solx/surface is a file: dep, not workspace:*, unlike its siblings — @solx/http is meant to be consumed from outside this Bun workspace too (e.g. solx-web/web via a plain file: dependency, with no vendor-copy step), and workspace:* only resolves inside a workspace that includes this package.
